summary: The diff implements WeakMap.prototype.set in its file by delegating to support helpers (this_weak_map, can_be_held_weakly, collection_key, weak_map_table). Steps are in spec order: RequireInternalSlot via this_weak_map with ? propagation, then the CanBeHeldWeakly check throwing a TypeError, then the entry update or append via OrderedTable::set, then returning the map. No test-shaped branches, no made-up values, no swallowed errors. The helper bodies are not in the diff, so their correctness is unverified; I answered from the call sites only.
